name: content-creator
title: Content Creator
description: Transform your creativity into cognitive publications

phases.title: Learn
phases.description: Master Web3 visual literacy and understand NFT art economics
phases.mission: Study NFT art cases, licensing models, and create your first visual asset

phases.title: Build
phases.description: Produce a generative art series using AI and creative tools

phases.title: Prove
phases.description: Submit your work for peer review and mint Proof-of-Creation™
phases.mission: Submit portfolio for community evaluation and receive Proof-of-Creation™ certification

phases.title: Activate
phases.description: Launch your creator brand and build your audience
phases.mission: Establish your Web3 creator presence and monetize your first collection

phases.title: Scale
phases.description: Join Creator DAO and unlock sustainable creative income
phases.mission: Become a recognized creator, mentor others, and earn royalties
